# Fate UI v0.9.8-beta5

Workspace preferences should be set before the AI starts delegating, not on each team afterward. This release moves that choice into Settings and removes the manual setup from Run → Agents.

## Set it once in Settings

Open **Settings → Agent → Subagent workspaces**:

- **Prefer isolated worktrees** is on by default. Turn it off to prefer a shared checkout instead.
- **Strict mode** is off by default. Leave it off to let the agent choose the other workspace mode when a task calls for it. Turn it on to require your chosen mode: incompatible launches and resumed work are refused by the backend.

Changes apply after saving, including to future work in teams that already exist. You do not need to stop the AI, create a team, or reopen the project to change the workspace policy. Running turns stay in their current checkout; existing work is never moved or discarded by a settings change.

## A quieter Agents panel

The per-team workspace defaults form and manual **New team** button are gone. The AI creates teams as needed. Run → Agents remains the place to follow their activity, review changes, make checkpoints, integrate approved commits, and clean up retained worktrees.

## For agent-driven workflows

`get_agent_workspace_policy` reports the current preference and strict flag. Per-spawn workspace, base-ref, and branch choices remain available within that policy. The old `configure_agent_workspace` tool is no longer exposed, and beta4 team defaults cannot override the global setting.

Workspace tool replies now include the checkout and bounded review details in text the agent can read. Reviews too large for that context remain blocked from integration until reviewed through the UI. Strict-refused follow-ups and direct-message turns are recorded as failed instead of being left queued to run later.

Automatic GoalMax reviews use the current project checkout when policy is flexible. Strict isolated reviews require a clean, committed project, so verification does not accidentally inspect an older version of your work.

## Compatibility and downloads

Workspace policy applies to **Agent Teams V2**. Legacy subagents keep their existing behavior, and the selected orchestration protocol is not changed by this update. Upgrading preserves other settings and starts the new workspace preference with isolated worktrees preferred and Strict mode off.

A worktree is still not an operating-system sandbox; Full access remains unsandboxed. Git requirements, explicit review/integration, and safe cleanup checks still apply.

Native installers are verified and smoke-tested on Windows x64, macOS Apple Silicon, macOS Intel, and Linux x64 before publication. Public beta installers are unsigned; verify downloads against `SHA256SUMS` and back up important work before upgrading.
